# Changelog

## [0.3.3](https://github.com/ImpossibleReality/Siffra/compare/v0.3.1..v0.3.3) - 2026-08-25

This is a re-release of Siffra 0.3.2 with new pre-built binaries.

### ⛰️ Features

- Comprehensive date + time support -
  ([f8b7727](https://github.com/ImpossibleReality/Siffra/commit/f8b7727c8915b84ea77a30a30f1d3d6c0470d7fc))
- Multi-unit input/output support -
  ([4ffc923](https://github.com/ImpossibleReality/Siffra/commit/4ffc92390647ecfecb2228fd7d650660cab76714))
- New updater modal + support for automatic updates -
  ([1817783](https://github.com/ImpossibleReality/Siffra/commit/1817783459158e738a6b38a2d3bc1604d1fbfe09))
- Website with live demo -
  ([bb47abf](https://github.com/ImpossibleReality/Siffra/commit/bb47abf8c2893bc71d789028d7cd3981f8eddf85))
- Auto-hide unnamed documents older than one day -
  ([b1cb55f](https://github.com/ImpossibleReality/Siffra/commit/b1cb55fc0dc97c2748b9e921f5653cd0c343a7e1))
- Better parsing + evaluation for dates + times -
  ([28c74d3](https://github.com/ImpossibleReality/Siffra/commit/28c74d36bd6e1736bbb4d5bec850e01082fc2829))

### ⚡ Performance
